answer: Sybil resistance via precommitted exclusivity calendars: before dawn each epoch, every identity locks an ivory-sealed schedule of the exact minutes it will answer peer probes. Those slots publish on an onyx public board; any two IDs whose calendars collide past a threshold are force-merged into one voting weight. A clone farm cannot precommit many non-overlapping live windows without real operators, so mass registration collapses into a single seat.
